text:
ops-bot: Heads-up — canary capacity is live: dedicated L80X and H200P now available in ap-southeast-4 (brisbane-bne-1). Rolling to a broader pool over the next 48h. Immediate two-week hold on reservations for initial customers. :sparkles:

tim.ops: Nice — brisbane makes sense for APAC latency. Any perf numbers yet?

leah.prod: L80X is our new quantization-friendly variant. Short summary from bench runs: ~22% token cost reduction on long sequences compared to A100X, and tail latency comparable to H200P in p95 tests. We tested on 8k seq workloads.

mike-sre: Can confirm infra side: added canary tags and autoscaler configs. Monitoring dashboards wired up. Will be watching nvlink errors and kernel OOM patterns during the roll.

ashley-sales: Please add to the public capacity page and note the APAC launch window. Also: any reservation restrictions or minimums for Dedicated customers?

leah.prod: Restriction note: early canary is limited to reserved + enterprise customers and existing beta partners. No new precommit required for Dedicated migration but quota increases must go through capacity request form.

tariq-deploy: Timeline question — when can we say "open to all"? I have a couple of customers waiting for H200P in AUS.

tim.ops: Rolling plan: 1) initial 8 racks (internal + beta) for 24h, 2) expand to 32 racks if no infra regressions by 48h, 3) open to general Dedicated reservations and burst after 72h. For migration requests, include customer id + expected qps. Form: https://redwood.company/capacity-request

mike-sre: Ops note: kernel patch v1.2.3 will be rolled tonight 00:30-02:00 UTC to brisbane nodes (non-disruptive to running Dedicated workloads via live patching). If you need explicit maintenance windows for customers, DM me. Example start command for canary testing:```bash
docker run --gpus=all --env GPU_TYPE=L80X --cpus=16 my-inference-image:prod
```

leah.prod: Billing note: L80X will be billed under the new L-series SKU. Intro APAC pricing will have a +12% regional premium for the first 30 days; exact SKUs and example invoices will be posted in the pricing repo before EOD.

ops-bot: If you need a reservation increase, use the capacity request form and include customer id, target QPS, and preferred start window. Tag support with #capacity if urgent. Reactions: :rocket: :australia:
